text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the installation of speed humps on Bala Avenue, between Bartonville Avenue West and Jane Street. Staff's assessment indicates the criteria as set out in the updated Traffic Calming Policy has been satisfied. Therefore, speed humps should be installed on Bala Avenue.

The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of speed humps on Bala Avenue, between Bartonville Avenue West and Jane Street. 2. Directed the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter the roadway for the installation of two speed humps on Bala Avenue, between Bartonville Avenue West and Jane Street, generally as shown on Attachment 2 to the report (April 25, 2024) Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services.
